title: Graduate a channel post to Knowledge (the retention-safety bridge)

story.as_a: coding agent that posted something worth keeping past 30 days
story.i_want_to: graduate a channel post into the durable Knowledge plane
story.so_that: a genuinely reusable lesson survives the channel's 30-day expiry — making 'the transient roll can be short because keepers escalate' literally true

rationale: v1's 30-day hard delete is justified by 'keepers graduate to Knowledge (#411)', but v1 ships no first-class path — it rests on a human doing knowledge_create manually. This story closes that: a one-call promotion from a channel post to a knowledge article, so the retention-safety story is real, not aspirational. It is the ONLY v2 story that touches durability, so it must reuse Knowledge's existing guardrails rather than inventing a bypass.

background.reference: docs/repo-coordination-bus.md §3.4, §6; Loopctl.Knowledge.create_article + the #411 memory-graduation worker as prior art
background.includes: Mirrors the existing memory->knowledge graduation (MemoryGraduationSweepWorker) provenance + novelty-gate pattern, but agent-triggered on a single post.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /api/v1/channel/posts/:id/graduate (agent role) fetches the post tenant-scoped (needs a Coordination.get_post/2 public path — v1 ships only list + an internal delete lookup, so add it) and creates a knowledge article from it (title required, body from the post body, project_id carried over, tags). The source post is then either deleted (via US-39.7) or kept (the sweep reclaims it in 30d) — do NOT mark it 'graduated' (the US-39.1 schema has no such column).

Graduation goes through the SEMANTIC NOVELTY gate by calling Loopctl.Knowledge.propose_article/3 (NOT create_article/3): a near-duplicate returns {verdict: :duplicate, article: existing, created: false} and creates nothing. Because create_article/propose_article do NOT run a secret scan, the shared secret-denylist helper (factored out in US-39.1) is ALSO run over the post body as an explicit separate step before graduation — an agent cannot smuggle a secret or a duplicate into the durable plane via this path. Project/tenant ownership is enforced.

The resulting article carries provenance: source_type indicating channel-graduation and a reference to the originating post/agent, and is attributed to the graduating agent, so durable content is traceable to its channel origin.

Graduation is rate-bounded by the existing limiter (per-api_key and per-tenant buckets — note there is NO per-agent bucket in the limiter) so it cannot be used to bulk-flood Knowledge from the channel.
A channel_graduate(post_id, title?, tags?) MCP tool is added (agent key) and shipped in the mcp-server publish.

test_cases.name: graduate a post creates an attributed article
expected_results: a knowledge article is created with the post body + project_id

test_cases.name: near-duplicate graduation dedups (no new article)
preconditions: an existing article near-identical to the post
expected_results: deduplicated: returns the existing article id, no duplicate created

test_cases.name: secret in the post body blocks graduation
preconditions: a post whose body contains a token-shaped string

technical_notes: Graduate via Loopctl.Knowledge.propose_article/3 (knowledge.ex:418) — it wraps create_article with the ProposalGate/proposal_assessor novelty gate and returns {:ok, %{verdict: :duplicate, article, created: false}} on a near-dup (exactly TC-40.1.2's shape). create_article/3 (knowledge.ex:293) does ONLY exact-idempotency dedup + ownership + length caps — it does NOT run the novelty gate and there is NO secret scan in it or in article.ex.
Run the shared secret-denylist helper (the one US-39.1 factors out of the extractor's denylist) over the post body as an explicit step BEFORE propose_article — the create path won't do it for you.
Add Loopctl.Coordination.get_post(tenant_id, post_id) (public, tenant-scoped, UUID-guarded) — v1 (Epic 39) only ships list (39.3) + an internal delete lookup (39.7).
Provenance: set source_type (e.g. "channel_graduation") + a source reference to the post id; attribute to the agent per #163.
Post-graduation fate: keep (sweep reclaims in 30d) OR delete via US-39.7 — NOT a 'graduated' flag (no column).
MCP: add channel_graduate alongside the other channel tools.
